texts.text: 中 国 江 阴 澄 星 万 豪 酒 店
阶 段 二 公 共 區 方 案 汇 报
19 th J a n u a r y , 2017
二零一七 年 一 月 十九 日
L35 CHINESE RESTAURANT & PRIVATE DINING ROOM

Jiangyin City is located in eastern China, southern Jiangsu Province northern Taihu Plain on the Yangtze River Delta. This city stands at the  beginning of the Yangtze River and the gateway to the ocean.

Jiangyin has been playing an important role in use military, for it is an excellent river port and essential transportation hub, crisscrossed by  numerous rivers and lakes. The captioned project is at the east of Huashan Road and south of the Chengjiang Street of Jiangyin City,  ten minutes walk to the city center.
江阴位于中国华东，江苏省南部，长江三角洲太湖平原北端。江阴地处江尾海头、长江咽喉，历代为江防要塞，是大江南北的重要交通枢纽和江河湖海 联运换装的天然良港.此項目位於花山路東,位於江阴市澄江街道之南方,距離市中心伋步行十分鈡路程. 澄星萬豪酒店距離无锡机场約40分钟車程.
Jiangyin Chengxing Marriott Hotel is 38 minutes car transportation to Wuxi Train Central Station and 47 minutes to Wuxi Airport.
澄星萬豪酒店距離无锡火車站約38分钟車程，而无锡机场只需約47分钟車程.
